chunks: It is He who created you from a single cell, and from it created its mate, that you may live as companions. When the man covered the woman she conceived a light burden and carried it about. And when she was heavy (with child) they prayed together to their Lord: "If You bestow a healthy son on us we shall truly be grateful."

key_terms.لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا: that he may find tranquility in her

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the creation of man and woman and the stages of pregnancy?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is foundational for understanding the ontological unity of humanity and the divine wisdom behind marital companionship as a means of spiritual tranquility (sakina). The progression from a 'light burden' to a 'heavy one' during pregnancy is often interpreted as a subtle sign of God’s power, culminating in the couple’s vow of gratitude upon receiving a righteous child, reflecting the Shia emphasis on thankfulness (shukr) as a core virtue.
